name: Avi
player_statement:
A complete player, Avi has made a big mark in cricket. With 13 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 40, with an average of 20.75 and a quick strike rate of 103.75. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 12 sixes and 6 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 12.5 overs, taking 10 wickets at an economy rate of 7.56. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
